t: You're at the site of the Byam Shaw School of Art, an independent art school that offered foundation and degree-level courses in fine art. It was founded in 1910 by two artists. John Byam Liston Shaw was a painter, illustrator, designer and teacher. Rex Vicat Cole was an English landscape painter. In 2003 the school was absorbed by Central Saint Martins College of Arts and Design, so it no longer runs as a separate school, but its name lives on in that merger.
